structural_breaks.note: FY2019: the four printed quarter columns sum to HRK 2,860.4m vs FY cumulative 2,811.8m; H1-2019 cumulative later restated (−48.6m) in the H1-2020 report without changing the Q2 quarter column; 2018 FY comparative in the FY2019 report (2,492.6m) differs from the originally reported unaudited 2,681.5m. Quarter columns kept as printed.

IFRS 8 segments changed with the 2022 reports: from Transformatori / Rotacioni strojevi / Tračnička vozila / Inženjering / Industrijska elektronika (2020–2021) to Proizvodnja el. energije / Prijenos i distribucija / Tračnička vozila i infrastruktura (later Urbana mobilnost i infrastruktura) / Digitalna rješenja. 2021 was re-presented on the new basis in the 2022 reports; revenue_segment starts at FY2021Q1 from those restated comparatives.

Dalekovod d.d. group (transmission-line & substation EPC, 75.16%) integrated into Grupa KONČAR from 1 April 2022 (recapitalisation in Q1 2022); Dalekovod = 10.9% of H1-2022 and 14.8% of FY2022 sales, mostly inside the T&D segment. 2022 YoY growth of T&D is partly inorganic.
Reporting currency HRK → EUR (euro adoption, fixed 7.53450). Level series has a unit break; use prior_year_comparative (company-converted) for YoY.

Annual TFI notes for FY2024 and FY2025 present segment revenue NET of intersegment eliminations (segments sum to consolidated sales), while all interim reports present GROSS segment revenue with a separate eliminations line; Q4 segment values for 2024 and 2025 therefore cannot be derived consistently and are left out.
HELB d.o.o. (power-infrastructure engineering, Božjakovina) 75% control from 1 Aug 2025, 100% from 8 Apr 2026 (renamed KONČAR – Helb). Also ADNET/Kreanca (digital, 2025) and NEOS (Jan-2026).

profile.products: Grupa KONČAR T&D segment: KONČAR – D&ST (medium-power transformers & autotransformers up to 160 MVA / 170 kV; oil distribution 50 kVA–8 MVA ≤36 kV; dry-type 50–5,000 kVA; special transformers), KONČAR – Instrument Transformers (HV 72.5–800 kV, MV 3.6–52 kV), KONČAR – Transformer Tanks (tanks >100 t for large power transformers, exported to DE/AT/FR/NL/BE/US/KR), Ferokotao (tanks), Aparati i postrojenja (MV/LV switchgear), substation EPC up to 420 kV, Dalekovod (transmission lines). Large power transformers are made by KONČAR – Energetski transformatori, a JV with Siemens Energy that is equity-accounted (NOT in consolidated revenue). Other segments: generators/hydro turbines, rail vehicles (trams/trains), digital.

plants.products: KONČAR – D&ST distribution, medium-power and special transformers (up to 160 MVA/170 kV)
KONČAR – Transformer Tanks (LPT tanks, new facility 2025-26)
Ferokotao / Novi Feromont — transformer tanks & metal structures (via KONČAR – D&ST)
Power Engineering Transformatory (PET) — transformers (via KONČAR – D&ST)

profile.end_markets: Transmission & distribution utilities and renewables (wind/solar) in the EU (Germany, Nordics, Austria etc.), Croatia (HEP/HOPS), railway (HŽ), hydro. Export share of group sales ≈71% in H1-2026 (516.5 of 724.9 EUR m). T&D = ~75% of gross segment revenue in H1-2026.
export_routes: HR->US (tanks for LPT makers; JV power transformers are equity-accounted)

Croatian exports 650 kVA–10 MVA — D&ST distribution/medium transformers, the core of KONČAR's consolidated transformer revenue
Croatian production index of electric motors/generators/transformers/distribution apparatus (C27.1) — dominated by KONČAR companies
Croatian C27.1 turnover (nominal) — direct industry mirror of KONČAR T&D output
German C27.1 production — Germany is a major destination for D&ST/KONČAR exports; EU grid capex cycle
US imports of >10 MVA transformers from Croatia — mostly the equity-accounted Siemens Energy JV, so only indirect (tanks, instrument transformers)
Eurostat Comext monthly EU27 imports of HS8504 from Croatia (partner HR) — cleaner view of KONČAR's EU sales than world exports; not yet collected
